description: Port the Phoenix/Phoenix LiveView application into a self-contained native macOS bundle: local Swift stores, native audio/job engines, DJ/DAW/MIDI/sampler workflows, agent routing, and development showcase telemetry without a server runtime dependency.

user_stories.title: Single-bundle runtime and native shell
user_stories.description: Remove server status/dependency from the product shell and run against local Swift runtime state.

user_stories.title: Port Ecto schemas into Codable local stores
user_stories.description: Translate tracks, playlists, stems, jobs, settings, cue points, DAW projects, sampler banks, crates, and provider configuration into local Swift persistence models.

user_stories.title: Port audio jobs into local Swift processing queue
user_stories.description: Replace Oban workers and port modules with a native queue for import, download, analysis, stem planning, audio-to-MIDI, chord detection, warp, cleanup, and export.

user_stories.title: Port DJ, DAW, MIDI, sampler, and crate workflows
user_stories.description: Move decks, cue grids, arrangements, edit history, controller profiles, mappings, sample packs, pad actions, crate digging, and Big Loopy sets into native Swift modules.

user_stories.title: Port agents and provider routing without server dependency
user_stories.description: Translate music agents, LLM provider routing, tool contracts, and prompt state into local user-controlled Swift services.

user_stories.title: Ship as a self-contained signed macOS bundle
user_stories.description: Package the ported app with local runtime storage, import/export permissions, signing, notarization readiness, and no Phoenix launch requirement.
